column1: b01.0|I'll separate decisions, actions with owners and dates, and unresolved questions, then ask participants to confirm the workshop record.|I'll send the complete notes in time and ask Max to identify which statements should become approved requirements.|I'll summarize only the agreed solution and omit open questions until stakeholders resolve them in the next workshop.|Notes должны сохранять uncertainty и traceability. Полный transcript полезен как приложение; пропуск вопросов создаёт ложное согласие.

b02.0|A requirement states a stakeholder need or necessary capability with conditions that let us verify whether the need is met.|A requirement is a documented feature the business has asked developers to implement and demonstrate at the end of the sprint.|A requirement is an approved description of the screens and controls that users will see in the finished product.|Requirement шире feature request или UI. Нужны потребность, ограничения и проверяемость; решение ещё может меняться.

b03.0|Who needs the loan action, what are they trying to accomplish and why? Let's capture that before selecting a button as the solution.|I'll rewrite it as a customer wanting a loan button so they can click it, preserving the requested control in the standard format.|I'll add button placement and styling first, so designers can turn the story into an implementation-ready screen.|Форма As/I want/so that не заменяет value. Нажать кнопку — действие интерфейса, а не конечная потребность.

b04.0|Given a registered customer with a valid reset link, when they set a compliant password, then the new password works and the old one doesn't.|Given the customer wants access, when they click Reset, then they can log in successfully without specifying verification or password conditions.|Given the screen is open, when Reset is clicked, then show a confirmation message in the approved design style.|Acceptance criterion проверяет наблюдаемый результат при условиях. Happy path не заменяет отдельные expiry, invalid-token и security criteria.

b05.0|I'd include customers, product, card operations, engineering, QA, risk and compliance, then confirm who owns policy and approval decisions.|I'll list customers and product as stakeholders and ask engineering to represent operations, risk and implementation concerns in later reviews.|I'll invite every bank department and let attendance determine who needs approval rights for the card-limit feature.|Stakeholder не равно attendee. Нужны affected parties и decision rights; слишком широкий список без ролей тоже не управляет согласованием.

b06.0|What outcome follows this branch? I'll confirm whether it's a missing transition or an intentional endpoint before changing the diagram.|I'll connect the arrow to the next visible step and ask Rita to correct the draft if the inferred path is wrong.|I'll remove the dangling arrow to make the diagram readable, leaving exception handling for the detailed requirements document.|Нельзя исправлять смысл по внешнему виду. End state и missing branch различают по реальному процессу и правилам.

b07.0|Which latency percentile, load and measurement boundary should quickly mean? I'll agree measurable acceptance conditions with business and engineering.|I'll use a two-second response target because it is a common usability threshold, then ask Tom whether it is feasible.|I'll ask Tom for the fastest achievable time and use that as the requirement, keeping the business wording unchanged.|Feasibility не сама потребность. SLA требует percentile, объёма, границ и владельца; произвольные две секунды не согласованное требование.

b08.0|The main flow is drafted; one rule about phone verification is unresolved. I'll name the question, owner and next checkpoint.|I'll report seventy-percent completion and ask Max to inspect the document for any question that needs stakeholder input.|I'll mark the task blocked and stop documenting the independent parts until someone confirms the remaining phone-change rule.|Процент без остатка и blocker малоинформативен. Блокер одной ветки не всегда останавливает всю независимую работу.

b09.0|I found the daily-limit typo: $5,000, not $500. I'll send a clear correction and version note before anyone uses yesterday's document.|I'll quietly replace the file now because Max has not read it, avoiding an unnecessary correction message about an unused draft.|I'll leave the original file and explain the correct limit in chat, planning to consolidate the document after Max's review.|Неизвестно, кто ещё использовал файл. Нужны единый источник и явная correction, а не параллельные версии в chat.

b10.0|I'll read the old flow for context, mark assumptions and prepare specific questions, then validate current rules with the process owner before approving anything.|I'll use the two-year-old document as the current baseline and revise only the sections that contradict today's screens.|I'll wait for Max rather than read the old document, preventing outdated material from influencing the analysis.|Исторический источник полезен как гипотеза, не current truth. Наблюдение UI тоже не доказывает все business rules.

b11.0|What problem needs a second number, who uses it and under which conditions? I'll confirm purpose and validation before adding personal-data collection.|I'll add an optional second-number field with the first field's validation, minimizing the implementation while leaving usage to Rita.|I'll ask engineering to estimate the field first and use the estimate to decide whether the request needs further analysis.|Сначала purpose и ownership данных. Optional всё равно создаёт collection, storage и consent вопросы; дешёвая реализация не обосновывает need.

b12.0|Could you show where the main flow becomes unclear? I'll separate the overview from exceptions and return a revised draft for review.|I'll shorten every paragraph and move half the detail into footnotes, preserving the current structure to avoid a major rewrite.|I'll remove all exception paths so Max sees only the main scenario, leaving developers to discover edge cases during implementation.|Readable overview дополняет exception detail, не уничтожает его. Нужна конкретная обратная связь по структуре и уровню информации.

sc01.0|I'll check the workshop record and approved requirements now, flag the possible omission and give Tom and Helen a short update time.|I'll ask Tom to add the fee display immediately because a customer-facing charge should obviously be visible before release.|I'll confirm that the current specification contains no fee line and treat it as a new change request until Helen proves prior agreement.|Нужно проверить traceability и impact, не спорить о вине. Отсутствие в spec ещё не доказывает, что обязательство новое.

sc01.1|The agreed fee requirement was omitted. I'll acknowledge it and compare a verified minimal disclosure with postponement, keeping required customer information as a release condition.|I'll add the line as a minor change and keep tomorrow's date, asking QA to test it during the production rollout.|I'll postpone the full release for the two-day fix and use the extra time for a complete fee-display regression review.|Минимальное решение допустимо после оценки и проверки. Обязательную fee disclosure нельзя отдать на production experiment.

sc01.2|I'll trace workshop decisions into owned, reviewable requirements and tests, with stakeholder confirmation of omissions and unresolved questions before implementation.|I'll require a second analyst to attend every workshop, assuming duplicate notes will catch anything the first person misses.|I'll ask stakeholders to read all meeting notes themselves and treat silence by the next day as confirmation of complete requirements.|Дополнительный analyst может помочь, но нужен control перехода notes→requirements. Silence не approval без заранее согласованного процесса.

sc01.3|I'll show the original omission, the new decision-to-test trace and evidence from the two early clarifications, including the method's limits.|I'll present the new summary template as a mandatory standard and measure success by the number of documents using it.|I'll share the two success stories and skip the omission so colleagues focus on the improved process rather than the earlier mistake.|Template adoption — output, не качество. Пример должен объяснять механизм и честный урок, а не обещать отсутствие пропусков.

b13.0|Can you walk through a recent failed transfer, its frequency, impact and current workaround? I'll separate observed problems from possible solutions.|I'll ask Dana to rank proposed transfer features, using her support experience to identify the most useful backlog items.|I'll send a satisfaction survey to support agents and treat the highest-scoring complaint as the requirement to implement.|Конкретный incident уточняет need и evidence. Ranking решений преждевременен; proxy survey не заменяет реальный workflow.

b14.0|I'll mark the duplicate-phone scenario unresolved and agree identification and privacy rules before specifying selection, rejection or another safe outcome.|I'll let the customer choose between the two matching names, since a selection screen keeps the transfer journey simple.|I'll reject every duplicate-phone transfer automatically, treating the safest implementation as the approved business rule.|И раскрытие имён, и отказ требуют согласования. BA не выбирает policy молча; нужно проверяемое поведение и защита данных.

b15.0|Let's classify by the consequence of omission and dependencies, then fit the Must scope into capacity with Helen approving what is deferred.|I'll label Helen's first four requests Must and move the remaining four to Should, aligning the categories with this sprint's capacity.|I'll ask each stakeholder to choose one Must feature, distributing the limited capacity equally across interested departments.|MoSCoW не квота и не справедливый round-robin. Если Must не помещаются, нужен scope/date decision, не смена ярлыка.

b16.0|I'll confirm whether the threshold is > or >= $10,000 and add explicit below, equal and above examples to the acceptance criteria.|I'll interpret over as strictly greater and tell QA to exclude exactly $10,000, leaving the existing wording unchanged.|I'll include the boundary because it is more favorable to customers, then ask Helen to review that policy after testing.|Обычное значение over полезно, но владелец должен подтвердить спорный rule. Выгодность клиенту не даёт BA полномочий менять discount policy.

b17.0|The build matches the mandatory-email baseline. I'll verify the real business need and log any approved change separately from a defect against that baseline.|I'll classify it as a bug because operations cannot use the form without email, then ask engineering to remove the validation.|I'll reject Rita's report outright because the specification is unambiguous and therefore the implemented behavior must meet the business need.|Conformance и suitability — разные вопросы. Requirement может быть неверным; это не делает каждое расхождение defect автоматически.

b18.0|I'll define type, limits, source and transformation for each field with its owner, adding nullability and validation examples before sign-off.|I'll infer types and lengths from the existing screen and leave source-system mapping to the development team during implementation.|I'll copy the old database schema into the new field list, assuming legacy storage constraints remain the business contract.|UI и legacy schema — evidence, не approved contract. Источник, nullability и mapping влияют на качество и интеграцию.

b19.0|I'll observe where the person hesitates and test the task with more representative users, treating the issue as a signal.|I'll keep the design because two of three employees succeeded, documenting the third participant's confusion as an isolated preference.|I'll change the screen immediately to match that participant's suggestion, avoiding another round of testing before the release.|Малая usability sample обнаруживает проблемы, не оценивает population rate. Ни majority vote, ни один совет не определяют окончательный design.

b20.0|I'll ask Tom to break down assumptions, dependencies and unknowns, clarify requirement gaps and present a range without replacing engineering's estimate myself.|I'll add a twenty-percent contingency to Tom's three weeks and give Helen the resulting date as our agreed estimate.|I'll confirm three weeks because the requirements are complete, letting engineering explain any later deviation from its original number.|Complete requirements не исключают uncertainty. Contingency требует risk model; BA помогает оценке, не создаёт capacity арифметикой.

b21.0|I'll agree cleanup criteria, merge confirmed duplicates and review obsolete or unclear items with owners, keeping links and decisions for traceability.|I'll delete every item older than six months and ask product to recreate anything still important in the new backlog.|I'll rewrite all one hundred forty items to the same detail level before any new sprint planning can proceed.|Возраст не обоснование удаления. Refinement по приоритету экономит работу; полный detail для далёких items часто waste.

s01.0|Which users, task and observed difficulty matter most? I'll bring concrete examples and an agreed outcome to the design meeting.|I'll ask design to simplify navigation across the app and let their prototype reveal which usability problem matters most.|I'll convert easier into fewer clicks everywhere, using a measurable interaction count as the initial success criterion.|Меньше clicks не всегда лучше usability. Нужна задача, аудитория, evidence и критерий успешного выполнения.

s01.1|Let's identify the affected journey, baseline completion and complaint pattern, then agree a measurable target and guardrails with the owner.|I'll propose a ten-percent satisfaction increase and ask Helen to approve it as the measurable meaning of easier.|I'll use complaint count alone because it is already available, avoiding extra instrumentation while the requirement remains urgent.|Target не берётся произвольно. Complaint count зависит от объёма и каналов; metric должен отражать выбранную потребность.

s02.0|I'll map each field to an approval rule, check existing sources and explore progressive collection before agreeing the minimum defensible first step.|I'll compromise at ten fields, asking each stakeholder to choose which five of their preferred fields can be removed.|I'll prioritize the five-field journey because conversion is a measured product objective, leaving operations to collect missing data manually afterward.|Среднее не business rule. Progressive disclosure полезно, если необходимые данные собраны до соответствующего решения и есть ownership.

s02.1|Let's test both claims: which fields are legally or operationally required at each stage, and what evidence links their collection to abandonment?|I'll ask Rita to sign off on ten fields and Helen on the target conversion, assigning each owner responsibility for their preferred outcome.|I'll prototype five fields and treat higher completion in a quick usability test as proof the remaining ten are unnecessary for loan approval.|Usability не доказывает sufficiency для underwriting. Нужно проверить правила, источники, risk и измерение, а не раздать конфликтующие approvals.

s03.0|What confirmation do customers need to show, to whom and in what form? I'll validate that job before choosing a PDF for every transaction.|I'll add the requested PDF to completed payments only, narrowing the implementation while preserving Dana's proposed solution.|I'll use fewer support calls as the acceptance criterion and let engineering choose any confirmation format it can deliver quickly.|Need важнее requested control. Call reduction — outcome, не полное functional acceptance; формат определяется внешним пользователем подтверждения.

s03.1|I'll verify what landlords accept and pilot the simplest shareable proof for those payments, keeping other confirmation needs visible before selecting a format.|I'll add PDFs for all transactions because a single universal implementation avoids deciding which thirty percent of calls need another solution.|I'll build a landlord-specific sharing link and retire PDF export, assuming the seventy-percent majority covers the valuable use case.|Majority помогает priority, не отменяет меньшинство и acceptance внешней стороной. Universal solution тоже требует security и demand evidence.

sc02.0|I'll acknowledge the workflow impact and observe the real task with operators, separating missing requirements from new preferences before proposing recovery options.|I'll show Rita the signed requirements and ask her to identify the exact acceptance criterion the six-click screen violates.|I'll ask engineering to restore the old layout immediately, keeping the release date and treating operator familiarity as the main requirement.|Подписанный spec не доказывает пригодность. До решения нужны observed steps, последствия и validated constraints, не защита документа.

sc02.1|I'll map the duplicate entry and missing shortcut to user tasks, agree acceptance examples and estimate a corrected flow with engineering and QA.|I'll remove the duplicate income field and defer the shortcut because repeated data entry is the larger visible problem.|I'll add the shortcut first and keep the second income field for audit, assuming redundant entry protects data quality.|Обе проблемы надо связать с use case. Двойной ввод не audit control сам по себе; порядок fixes выбирают по impact и effort.

sc02.2|Four days of fixes plus two of testing exceed five days. I'll offer verified scope reduction or a revised date, preserving required acceptance checks.|I'll ask QA to test in parallel with implementation and commit to five days before confirming which scenarios can safely overlap.|I'll keep the release date and plan one day of testing, prioritizing the happy path while logging remaining scenarios for next sprint.|Overlap возможен только по готовым независимым частям. Нельзя экономить день тестирования без risk-based обоснования и approval.

sc02.3|I'll involve representative operators in workflow discovery and prototype validation, with explicit task-based acceptance before the final UAT window.|I'll add more operators to the final UAT and start it two days earlier, retaining the same discovery and design process.|I'll require Rita to approve every screen during development, making one senior stakeholder the sole representative of operator workflows.|Раннее наблюдение лучше позднего большого UAT. Один approval не заменяет representative workflows и доступных делегатов.

b22.0|I'll restate the question and decision, give silent writing time and invite each role's input before resolving disagreements against shared criteria.|I'll ask the two active participants to summarize the options and then hold a quick majority vote with all six attendees.|I'll split the workshop into two smaller groups and merge their preferred solutions afterward without another joint decision check.|Participation не гарантирует верное rule. Голосование полезно для preferences, но не отменяет обязательные constraints или decision rights.

b23.0|I'll observe operators and exceptions, validate the as-is map with its owner, then distinguish approved to-be changes from assumptions.|I'll use the current system screens as the as-is map and remove the visibly redundant steps to propose the to-be process.|I'll interview Rita only and treat her description as authoritative, reducing disruption to the operators' daily work.|Manager и UI не отражают все реальные handoffs и workarounds. To-be требует согласованной цели, а не эстетического сокращения шагов.

b24.0|I'll log the request, assess cumulative scope and dependencies, and ask the owner to approve a swap, added capacity or a changed date.|I'll accept this filter because it is small and establish formal change control starting with Helen's next request.|I'll reject every new request until the agreed release ships, preserving the baseline even if business priorities genuinely change.|Change control разрешает осознанное изменение, не blanket refusal. Мелкие additions имеют cumulative cost и должны оцениваться сейчас.

b25.0|I'll agree measurable performance, capacity, availability and security conditions with owners, specifying loads, percentiles and verification methods.|I'll ask Leo to provide standard technical defaults and copy them into the requirements without a separate business review.|I'll add fast, secure and scalable as non-functional criteria, leaving numerical thresholds to the system's future performance tests.|NFR требуют measurable fit criteria. Defaults — отправная точка, не доказательство соответствия потребности и регуляторным constraints.

b26.0|I'll confirm the rule's scope, dates and interpretation with compliance, map current retention and deletion behavior, then raise the verified gap and options.|I'll change the requirement to five years immediately and ask engineering to extend storage, treating the central-bank wording as self-explanatory.|I'll keep the one-year feature storage and rely on backups for the remaining four years.|Retention включает доступность, scope, legal hold и lifecycle. Backup не автоматически архив; interpretation подтверждает compliance.

b27.0|I'll map stable requirement IDs to test cases, review uncovered rules and justify exclusions; counts alone cannot demonstrate coverage.|I'll request twenty more tests so the number matches sixty requirements, ensuring each requirement appears to have its own check.|I'll ask QA to confirm all requirements were discussed in testing, treating team familiarity as sufficient coverage evidence.|Many-to-many traceability важнее совпадения counts. Один test может покрывать несколько правил, одно правило — много сценариев.

b28.0|I'll explain the scoring dependency and current capacity, then offer a scoped discovery or explicitly reprioritized release.|I'll start a chatbot-style interface now and add scoring later, keeping the quick-loan promise in the planned release description.|I'll reject the request because the sprint is full, asking Greg to resubmit only after current commitments finish.|Limited prototype допустим с честным названием. Нельзя продавать prequalification как approved loan или закрывать legitimate priority discussion.

b29.0|I'll demonstrate the executive decision and main customer outcome, include one relevant exception and end with the specific approval or question we need.|I'll show the most visually impressive options first and send business metrics afterward so the short demo remains engaging.|I'll cover every option rapidly to demonstrate completeness, using the last minute for any executive questions.|Demo поддерживает решение, не feature inventory. Exception и ограничения важны, если меняют approval или риск.

b30.0|I'll flag the dated API dependency, affected flows and owner now, then assess migration lead time and escalation triggers before it becomes an issue.|I'll add partner API change to the risk log and revisit it at the next monthly review without assigning an owner yet.|I'll ask engineering to migrate immediately and update the risk register once the implementation estimate is confirmed.|Нужны конкретные uncertain event и impact. Немедленный migration может быть верным, но не до проверки scope и dependencies.

s04.0|I'll separate the mandatory confirmation rule from the one-tap goal, confirm authority and document which paths can satisfy both without an unauthorized exception.|I'll use one-tap below five hundred dollars and ask compliance to accept an SMS exemption above that amount for returning customers.|I'll require SMS for every transfer, assuming the strictest implementation satisfies the customer-experience objective too.|Более строгий путь тоже имеет cost. Exception требует authorised policy decision; аналитик не создаёт exemption ради удобства.

s04.1|The internal five-hundred threshold remains binding until its owner approves a change. I'll compare risk and experience, then record any revised policy and tests.|I'll raise the threshold to one thousand immediately because the law supersedes the bank's more restrictive internal policy.|I'll preserve five hundred permanently and close discussion, treating internal policy as impossible to review even by its authorized owner.|Закон может задавать минимум, а policy — дополнительный control. Изменение возможно через правильные полномочия, не молча и не никогда.

s05.0|I'd map stakeholders, outcomes, current workflows and constraints, then validate assumptions through examples before baselining a proportionate set of requirements.|I'd write a complete specification in month one so engineering can work independently while stakeholders focus on their normal responsibilities.|I'd organize interviews and collect every requested feature before discussing business priorities, avoiding bias from early scope decisions.|Discovery и prioritization связаны. Полнота списка пожеланий не равно согласованный scope; documentation должна быть proportionate риску.

s05.1|I'd explore what changed and why, show impact on the baseline and agree a decision cadence and change authority with traceable commitments.|I'd freeze requirements after the first workshop and require the stakeholder to wait for the next project for any new idea.|I'd accept weekly changes and continuously update the document, treating agility as a reason to avoid formal impact assessment.|Agile не отменяет trade-offs. Freeze бывает оправдан для конкретного gate, но не универсальный запрет обратной связи.

s06.0|I'll walk through the goal, main and exception flows, key rules and test links, reserving time to record unresolved assumptions and owners.|I'll read the specification section by section so testers hear every requirement once and can ask questions at the end.|I'll show only the happy path and send exception rules by email, keeping the one-hour session short enough for everyone to attend.|Handover нужен для общего понимания риска. Подробный read-through может тратить время, а критичные exceptions нельзя спрятать в приложении.

s06.1|I don't know yet. I'll log the blocked-card transition, confirm the rule with its owner and update both specification and tests before that path is accepted.|I'll tell QA to reject the transfer because the card is blocked, using the safest-looking outcome until the next requirements review.|I'll let developers choose the transaction behavior and document their implementation afterward as the source of truth.|In-flight state требует policy и технического контракта. Safety intuition не определяет settlement, reversal или user-facing status.

sc03.0|I'll capture the requests and assess value, effort and dependencies against the agreed date, asking Helen and Greg to approve any changed baseline.|I'll add the three items to the release backlog because both senior stakeholders agreed verbally during the sprint review.|I'll protect the team by refusing the additions on the call, offering to discuss them after the current release is complete.|Verbal interest не подтверждённая capacity. Правильная граница — оценка и authorised choice, не молчаливое yes или автоматическое no.

sc03.1|Only one week remains beyond the four-week baseline; the two-week chart does not fit. I'll offer a scope swap, smaller assessed slice or later delivery.|I'll choose the spending chart because it has high value and only two weeks of effort, keeping the five-week release target.|I'll choose the one-week export because it fits, presenting schedule feasibility as proof it is the most valuable addition.|Feasibility и value различаются. High value не создаёт вторую неделю; low value fit не делает export обязательным.

sc03.2|We need an explicit trade-off: an assessed smaller chart or removed baseline work, otherwise a later date. Weekends aren't uncommitted capacity we can assume.|I'll ask Tom to overlap testing with chart development and preserve the promised date, using the team review to identify recoverable time.|I'll keep the date and chart, classifying remaining baseline features as stretch scope without asking their owners to approve the change.|Overlap и stretch должны быть согласованы и оценены. Обещание board не меняет dependency math или обязательные acceptance gates.

sc03.3|I'll maintain one visible baseline and change log, with a quick impact assessment and named approval before work or external promises change.|I'll require Greg to sign every individual backlog edit, ensuring all scope changes have executive visibility.|I'll reserve an extra twenty percent in every future sprint, treating that capacity as protection against any new request.|Governance должна быть proportionate. Buffer не покрывает неограниченный scope; executive gate на каждую мелочь создаёт bottleneck.

sc08.0|I'll map elapsed time across the full reissue journey with real cases and handoff evidence, keeping team claims as hypotheses until verified.|I'll ask each department to reduce its current processing time by half and compare the results next month.|I'll focus the investigation on the printing partner because both operations and logistics named it as a likely bottleneck.|Нужны timestamps и end-to-end flow. Совпадающие обвинения не evidence; локальная оптимизация может не уменьшить общий lead time.

sc08.1|The seven-day wait sits at an unowned dispatch handoff. I'll agree one accountable process owner, a dispatch trigger and measurable handoff expectations.|I'll ask logistics to send batches every day and treat that instruction as sufficient ownership for the full card-reissue process.|I'll automate batch dispatch immediately and leave the existing departmental responsibilities unchanged to avoid a reorganization.|Automation без accountability оставляет exceptions. Владелец end-to-end не обязан исполнять все steps, но отвечает за результат и escalation.

sc08.2|Six days improves twelve but still misses five. I'll track lead-time distribution, residual waiting and ownership, with review triggers and a next improvement test.|I'll declare the process successful because the new owner halved the delay, switching monitoring to monthly averages.|I'll set a five-day average target and ask teams to explain only cases above ten days, keeping the reporting burden small.|Target ещё не достигнут. Среднее скрывает tail; threshold выбирают по service promise, не удобству отчёта.

b31.0|Let's define whether no loans is a successful empty collection or a domain absence, then align status, schema and client behavior with existing API conventions.|I'll specify HTTP 404 because no loans means the requested resource does not exist.|I'll specify a zero balance object for every customer without loans, making client code simpler while leaving existence semantics implicit.|Нет универсального status без resource model. Empty collection и нулевой существующий loan различаются; решение нужно согласовать и тестировать.

b32.0|I'll trace the new loan type through eligibility, pricing, contracts, data, interfaces, reporting and tests, documenting affected owners and unchanged assumptions.|I'll add student to the loan-type enumeration and ask each development team to identify impacts during implementation.|I'll ask product to describe only the new student-loan screen, leaving shared downstream rules under the existing general loan requirements.|Новый enum может затронуть many systems. Impact analysis ищет зависимости до разработки, а не перекладывает обнаружение на teams.

b33.0|Could you show one real case that fails and its consequence? I'll book a focused follow-up and record the unresolved constraint.|I'll ask Rita to approve or reject the proposal by end of day, using a deadline to obtain a concrete business decision.|I'll present the remaining two minutes of evidence and treat no specific objection as acceptance of the proposed process.|Конкретный counterexample раскрывает rule. Deadline полезен, но не заменяет understanding; silence не approval.

b34.0|I'll build an owned mapping table with business meaning, exception handling and reconciliation tests, confirming where many-to-one mapping loses information.|I'll map each old status to its closest new label and retain the original value only in migration logs for troubleshooting.|I'll create twelve custom values in the new system so migration preserves every legacy distinction without requiring business review.|Сохранить meaning важнее labels. Loss и новые extensions требуют approved rules и downstream impact, не только удобства migration.
